main.description: Adds a custom emoji to a community. The bytes are uploaded to the community's own repo and the AppView writes the provider's record there with the community's credentials.

community.description: The community that owns the emoji.

name.description: The emoji's name without colons. Lowercase letters, digits and underscores.

pack.description: A pack of the community to add the emoji to.

provider.description: The emoji provider that writes the records. Defaults to the AppView's default provider.

input.description: The raw image bytes. The provider sets the size limit and the accepted types, which is 128000 bytes of image/png, image/webp or image/gif for blue.moji. The content type is sniffed rather than trusted.

errors.name: AuthRequired
errors.description: The request is missing, malformed, or unverifiable service auth.

errors.name: Forbidden
errors.description: The caller lacks the community.manage permission.

errors.name: CommunityNotFound
errors.description: No community exists at the given DID.

errors.name: InvalidName
errors.description: The name is not 2 to 32 characters of lowercase letters, digits and underscores.

errors.name: NameTaken
errors.description: The community already has an emoji with this name.

errors.name: PackNotFound
errors.description: No pack of this community exists at the given URI.

errors.name: UnsupportedProvider
errors.description: The emoji provider is unknown, or it does not support the requested operation.

errors.name: UnsupportedImage
errors.description: The bytes are not an image type the provider accepts.

errors.name: ImageTooLarge
errors.description: The image exceeds the provider's size limit.

errors.name: CredentialsUnavailable
errors.description: The AppView cannot act as the community because its stored credentials are missing or unusable.

errors.name: UpstreamFailure
errors.description: A PDS call the AppView depends on failed.
